settings.label: Cloudflare API token
settings.description: Create a custom token with Zone > Analytics > Read for this zone (dash.cloudflare.com > My Profile > API Tokens).

settings.label: Zone ID
settings.description: Cloudflare dashboard > your domain > Overview > API > Zone ID.

settings.label: Account ID
settings.description: Needed for page views and visits (Web Analytics). Cloudflare dashboard > Account home > the three dots next to your account > Copy account ID. The token also needs Account > Account Analytics > Read.

settings.label: Hostnames
settings.description: Optional. Comma separated, e.g. uebersaxsamuel.ch,www.uebersaxsamuel.ch. Limits the data to these hosts and hides your own site from the referrers.

network.purpose: Read traffic from the Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API
